name: Kinect bypass
description: Bypasses the physical Kinect boot requirement, fakes player presence during calibration while preserving the normal calibration/PASELI flow, and suppresses tracking/calibration caution paths.

name: 60 FPS limiter
description: Limits the game FPS to 60. Useful for high refresh rate monitors.

name: Attract Mode - Full Song Pool
description: Selects a random song from the entire live song vector in attract mode, skips tutorial/null/unavailable entries.

name: EXPERIMENTAL - Demo MASTER
description: Changes the demo/attract chart preview to the MASTER difficulty. This only changes the attract/demo setup path, normal credited gameplay difficulty selection is untouched.

name: Clean Capture - Hide gameplay visuals
description: KDM-2016080100 clean-recording patch. Hides the CREDIT/PASELI text and in-game UI. Also disables note hitsound/SFX. Use with STEALTH difficulty to hide the notes. Enable before launching, do not live-toggle.

name: Omnimix Patch
description: If you are using the Omnimix that came with data_mods and omni_sound folder, you MUST enable this!

name: Native 1080p Render
description: Renders at 1920×1080 with adjustments to UI positioning. Original 2D artwork (HUD/UI elements, song jackets etc) is not upscaled.

name: Fake Region
description: Overrides the region used for song license checks without altering UI language. Select Japan for all songs to be unlocked.

name: OMNIMIX ONLY - Enable Alternate Audio Song Entries
description: Adds the Fubuki version of Oboro (朧) from SDVX and Everybody's Circulation as separate song-select entries. Alternate version scores will be shared with the original Oboro and Renai Circulation entries.
